theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Chip Stocks Slide Into Bear Market in AI Unwind: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: A selloff in chipmakers gathered pace, driving the high-profile group of stocks to a bear market on worries that the artificial-intelligence spending spree is becoming harder to justify.

top_news.title: Gauge of Oracle’s Credit Risk Hits Fresh All Time High
top_news.summary: A measure of Oracle Corp.’s credit risk hit a record high on Friday as concerns grew about both the company’s aggressive cash-burn and the future profitability of its artificial intelligence investments amid a new Chinese model that could rival offerings from companies like OpenAI.

top_news.title: CoreLogic Wraps Up $5.25 Billion Debt Deal With Hefty Yields
top_news.summary: CoreLogic Inc. raised $5.25 billion from a debt sale after amending the terms and offering some of the year’s highest yields in response to lukewarm investor demand.

top_news.title: ‘Sea of Red’ Hits Emerging Stocks as AI Concerns Jolts Markets
top_news.summary: Emerging-market stocks slumped, with a key gauge sliding into technical correction on mounting concerns the outlook for artificial intelligence no longer justifies the industry’s elevated valuations.

top_news.title: AI Upheaval Crushes Retail Traders Crowding Into Leveraged Funds
top_news.summary: A surprise breakthrough from Chinese startup Moonshot rippled through global markets Friday, sending AI and semiconductor stocks sharply lower and reviving memories of last year’s so-called DeepSeek moment. It was the latest reminder that markets are being reshaped at extraordinary speed and that assumptions about tomorrow’s winners can change almost overnight.

top_news.title: Gold Trims Weekly Drop on Dip-Buying Despite Rate Hike Odds
top_news.summary: Gold trimmed its weekly loss as some investors bought on dips after the precious metal broke below a key price level, even as escalating war tensions kept interest rate hike bets alive.

top_news.title: Hedge Fund Blasts SEC Settlement After ‘Gag Rule’ Lifted
top_news.summary: Connecticut hedge fund Deccan Value Investors is speaking out about its 2022 settlement of Securities and Exchange Commission claims that it breached its fiduciary duty to two university endowments after the regulator recently lifted its so-called gag rule.

top_news.title: US Stocks End Week Lower on Fears of Another ‘DeepSeek Moment’
top_news.summary: US stocks finished the week lower as semiconductor names dipped following the reveal of an artificial-intelligence model from a Chinese startup.

top_news.title: Sweetgreen Pares Drop as Parasite Tied to Taco Bell Lettuce
top_news.summary: Sweetgreen Inc. shares surged on Friday, halting a four-day skid, after US regulators said a parasite outbreak that’s sickened thousands across several states was traced to shredded iceberg lettuce served at Taco Bell restaurants.

top_news.title: Chips Stocks Sink Into Bear Market as 105% AI Rally Fizzles
top_news.summary: A closely watched index of semiconductor stocks fell into a bear market, unwinding a chunk of the blistering memory-led rally that saw the gauge more than double in just three months.
